failures.issue: Multi-select correct-answer choice text states 'The asset has an alternative use' but ASC 606-10-25-27(c) requires the asset to have NO alternative use. The choice text is factually the opposite of GAAP. The Explanation correctly says 'no alternative use' but the learner-facing choice is wrong.
failures.learner_impact: Learner who selects this as correct learns the opposite of GAAP — that ASC 606 over-time criterion allows alternative use (it does not).
failures.fix_required: Change choice text to 'The asset does NOT have an alternative use and the entity has an enforceable right to payment for performance completed to date' or similar.
